Lace-Up is the traditional pairing with red leather. The laces pull the wrist into a flat, even wrap, which many boxers prefer for sparring because it limits wrist movement on impact. The only catch is that you need a partner or coach to tie them.

nodes.title: White Cleto Reyes Boxing Gloves: Technique-Feedback Training Pair (Lace-Up/Velcro)
nodes.descriptionHtml:

The 60-second routine that keeps them white

  1. Wipe the striking surface and cuff with a soft cloth after every session.
  2. Air-dry them open, away from radiators and direct sun.
  3. Store them in a ventilated bag, not sealed in a locker.

Skip that routine for a few weeks and light leather greys in a way that does not fully reverse, so this is genuinely the highest-upkeep colour in the range.

nodes.descriptionHtml:
The big question with a two-closure glove is simple: Lace-Up or Velcro? These Cleto Reyes Metallic Blue & Gold gloves come in both, so here is how to decide, whichever you pick.

Lace-Up: when wrist control matters most

Laces pull the wrist and cuff into a flat, even wrap that moves very little on impact. Boxers usually choose Lace-Up for sparring, coached sessions and fight-style photos. The trade-off is that you need someone to tie them.

Velcro: when speed and independence matter

A strap closure lets you glove up alone in seconds, adjust mid-session, and swap pairs between drills. It suits solo bag work, circuits and busy schedules.

The glove itself

Deep blue metallic leather with gold detail, in 8oz, 10oz, 12oz, 14oz and 16oz. It takes the blue-corner idea and makes it formal: the metallic finish and gold accents look right on fight night.

Related options

For a plainer blue, see the Royal Blue. For another gold-accent pair, see the Metallic Green & Gold. Browse all styles in the Cleto Reyes gloves collection. Dry cloth only on the metallic trim.
